faq.label: QUESTIONS & ANSWERS
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Straightforward answers to common questions from business owners.
faq.q1: What is included in year-1 hosting and domain?
faq.a1: Every package includes one full year of high-speed cloud hosting on global edge servers and one standard domain registration (.in or .com). Renewal after year 1 is billed at our transparent annual maintenance rate.
faq.a2: A revision round is one consolidated list of changes to existing layout, text, or styling sent together in one message. This allows us to implement your feedback systematically and keep your launch on schedule. Additional rounds can be added if needed.
faq.q3: What if I or my customers only speak Hindi or Marathi?
faq.a3: We build truly multilingual websites with native Hindi and Marathi toggles, crafted by native speakers without automated translation errors. Our team can also conduct all calls and WhatsApp discussions in Hindi or Marathi.
faq.q4: Do I need to be in Mumbai to work with you?
faq.a4: No. While SHREEJAN AI SOLUTIONS is based in Mumbai, we build for clients across all Indian cities and towns. All discovery, previews, and support happen smoothly over phone, video calls, and WhatsApp.
faq.q5: How long does the project take from start to finish?
faq.a5: Starter sites are delivered in 7-10 working days, Growth in 14-18 days, and Business or Premium in 21-35 days. Timelines begin when we receive your initial deposit and project requirements.
faq.q6: What do I need to provide, and what is the Asset Pack option?
faq.a6: You provide your business details, photos, and any existing text. If you do not have photos, text, or branding ready, our Asset Packs provide professional copy, brand identity, and licensed imagery so you don't have to write anything yourself.
faq.q7: Who owns the website and code after launch?
faq.a7: You have 100% full ownership of your domain, website code, brand graphics, and content as soon as the final milestone payment is completed. You are never locked into our agency.
faq.q8: What happens after the included support period ends?
faq.a8: Your website continues running independently. If you want continued backups, security updates, and regular content edits, you can opt into our monthly Care plans, or request one-off updates whenever needed.
faq.more_questions: Have more questions? Speak directly with our technical team.

illustrative.p2: With a custom website and an automated assistant, the site answers questions immediately in English, Hindi, or Marathi, collects the visitor's details, and sends an appointment confirmation straight to the owner's WhatsApp.
illustrative.p3: The owner wakes up to organized leads ready for a studio visit without answering repetitive calls during personal hours.
